ideas.idea: Fix the sitemap listing /guides while the server sends noindex (remove header or sitemap entry)
ideas.why: This is a specific conflict in the files, but it restates the known noindex-on-/guides problem.

ideas.idea: Add real content to the Guides page, listing each route with name, grade and length as text
ideas.why: guides.vue only promises graded routes and lists none, so adding them gives crawlers and readers real content.

ideas.idea: Create a separate page per route (/guides/<name>) with its own title, description and sitemap entry
ideas.why: It is concrete and conditional on the routes list, and gives each route its own indexable URL.

ideas.idea: Add descriptive text and links to guides on the home page
ideas.why: index.vue has only an h1 and a button, so a short description with real links would help both readers and crawlers.

ideas.idea: Add an absolute canonical tag per page using the real domain
ideas.why: No canonical or site URL is set anywhere in the repo, and the sitemap uses a placeholder domain.

ideas.idea: Add WebSite/Organization JSON-LD with the name Trailhead and its URL
ideas.why: This is accurate but is standard advice for almost any site and has little effect on a small site.

ideas.idea: Generate the sitemap with a Nuxt sitemap module and add lastmod dates
ideas.why: This is sound but applies to any Nuxt site, and a two-URL static sitemap works fine.

ideas.idea: Remove the redundant /admin noindex or robots disallow
ideas.why: The report only notes the redundancy and leaves it alone, and /admin is a deliberate choice.
